name: quantity-ci

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  quantity-ci:
    name: quantity-ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm test
